title: The Quiet Trucks on Station Lane
synopsis: After the open day, Rex, Gus, Jack and Molly bring their discoveries together in a drawing of the newly familiar firehouse and settle into their different homes.
continuity_state: Before: The firehouse open day is ending. Rex, Molly, Gus and Jack have seen the engine compartments, aerial ladder demonstration, protective clothing, and water practice. The crews have returned equipment to storage. After: Season Seven closes with Station Lane and the firehouse added to Jack's notebook map: two red bays, a shorter pumper engine and longer aerial ladder truck, and Captain Ann as a recurring neighbor. The trucks and gear remain at their station ready for future calls. Molly returns to Green Gate Farm with Farmer Ruth; Rex, Gus and Jack go home with Aunt Jo. No incident or open-day job remains unfinished.
